meta.description: Free chimney inspection anywhere in Toronto and the GTA: WETT-certified technician, 19-point check, camera photos, and a {{site.offer_price}} sweep this winter. Open 7 days.

lp-hero.h1: Free Chimney Inspection At Your Home {{site.offer_price}} Chimney Sweep This Winter
lp-hero.p: A WETT-certified technician comes out, checks 19 points inside and out, photographs what he finds and tells you the exact price — before anything starts. If all you need is a sweep, that is {{site.offer_price}} this winter.
lp-hero.t-2: Prefer to talk? We answer {{site.hours}}, every day.

why.p: Not promises — just how every visit works.
why.p-2: Our work is carried out by a WETT-certified technician — the Wood Energy Technology Transfer certification Canadian insurers and home inspectors recognise.
why.p-3: A camera goes inside the flue. You get the photos, so you are not taking our word for it.
why.h3-3: Know The Price Before Work Starts
why.p-4: The technician gives you the exact price at your home, after the inspection. Nothing starts until you say yes.
why.p-5: If something doesn’t need fixing, we tell you. If it can wait, we tell you that too.

faq.q: Will the sweep make a mess in my house?
faq.p-2: No. Floors and the fireplace area are covered before any tool comes out, the vacuum runs the whole time we sweep, and the area is left the way we found it — or cleaner. That is step one of every visit, not an extra.
faq.q-2: Is the inspection really free, or is there a catch?
faq.p-3: It is free. A technician comes to your home, works through the 19-point check and gives you the price on the spot. If you decide not to go ahead, you pay nothing and you still have the photos and the report.
faq.q-3: Will you try to sell me a repair I don’t need?
faq.p-4: No. If something doesn’t need fixing, we say so, and if it can wait, we tell you that too. You see the photos of whatever we do recommend, so you are not taking our word for it.
faq.q-4: Do you work Saturdays and Sundays?
faq.p-5: Yes. We work every day, {{site.hours}}, weekends included — at the same price as a weekday.
faq.q-5: How long does a sweep take?
faq.p-6: It depends on the chimney’s condition and access. We give you a realistic window when we confirm the booking, and we stay until it is done properly.
faq.q-6: What if you find something during the sweep?
faq.p-7: We show you the photos, explain what it means, and give you a price for the repair. What happens next is your call — the sweep is still {{site.offer_price}} either way.
faq.p-8: Yes. The work is carried out by a WETT-certified technician — the certification Canadian insurers and home inspectors ask about.

book-bottom.h2: Pick A Time For Your Free Inspection
book-bottom.p: Choose a day and a window that suit you. We confirm by phone within the hour — every day, {{site.hours}}, weekends included.
book-bottom.p-2: Every Day {{site.hours}}. If we miss your call, we call right back.

footer.p: Chimney cleaning, inspection and repair for homeowners across Toronto and the GTA. The inspection at your home is free, and you get the exact price before any work starts.
